product.name: Symthaea Converse + Observe
product.goal: Provide a small Rust/WASM web interface for querying the Symthaea service gateway and observing daemon liveness and turn-synchronous cognitive telemetry.
user_roles: operator connecting to a Symthaea service gateway
developer inspecting conversation and telemetry behavior
non_goals: This v0 contract does not specify the deferred Steward or Bench panes.
This contract does not claim telemetry is continuously emitted while the daemon is idle.
This is a source-observed baseline, not a product approval or browser conformance report.

regions.purpose: Primary application landmark and page layout.
Application identity, gateway selection and daemon status.
Reports daemon liveness independently from telemetry.
Groups cognitive telemetry and living-organism visualization.
Visualizes affective valence and thermodynamic load.
notes: Decorative visual is hidden from the accessibility tree.

regions.purpose: Displays the most recently received CycleMetadata fields.
Displays cognitive self-portrait and imagination projections when present.
Groups transcript, errors and message composer.
Appends user and Symthaea conversation turns.
Announces the most recent query or gateway error.
Submits a non-empty user message to the gateway.
Accepts a text message for Symthaea.
Submits the current message; disabled while a request is in flight.

transitions.guard: gloo-net WebSocket state() returns State::Open before the 10-second handshake timeout.

state_machines.observability: The UI dot is connected only while the browser WebSocket state is OPEN. Disconnected, connecting and retry_wait all render as not connected; the UI does not yet display a separate reconnecting label.

transitions.side_effect: Append the assistant response to the transcript.
Expose the error in an alert region.

state_machines.observability: The send control is disabled while sending; the user turn is appended before the request completes.

data_sources.purpose: Send a user query to the Symthaea service facade.
data_sources.response_shape: JSON response with content or error type/message.

data_sources.purpose: Poll daemon status every five seconds.
data_sources.response_shape: JSON status with uptime_seconds, requests_processed and sleep_cycles.

data_sources.purpose: Receive turn-synchronous CycleMetadata telemetry when the daemon experience bridge is enabled.
data_sources.response_shape: JSON payload with flattened CycleMetadata fields and optional projection data.
failure_states: handshake does not reach OPEN within ten seconds

invariants: No horizontal page overflow at any declared reference viewport.
Gateway input remains visible and editable when the header wraps.
Conversation turns remain within the viewport width.
Message input and submit action remain usable without horizontal scrolling.
Required telemetry readouts remain available when the layout reflows.

accessibility.target: WCAG 2.2 AA as the design target; no conformance claim is made by this source-observed contract.
semantics: One main landmark contains the application.
Gateway liveness is exposed as a polite status region.
Conversation updates use a polite log region.
Query errors are announced as alerts.
Message input has the accessible name Message Symthaea.
The decorative telemetry orb is excluded from the accessibility tree.
keyboard_requirements: Gateway input, message input and send button are keyboard reachable.
Visible focus styling is present for primary input and submit controls.
A keyboard-only user can submit a message and find the resulting transcript entry.
accessibility.reduced_motion: The telemetry orb animation is disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.
manual_checks_required: Verify keyboard-only completion in a real browser.
Verify screen-reader announcements for transcript updates, status and errors.
Verify focus order and visibility at mobile and desktop viewport sizes.
Verify the reduced-motion behavior in a browser with the preference enabled.

untrusted_inputs: Gateway status, query responses and telemetry JSON are remote/untrusted inputs.
Mental-movie frame dimensions, channel count and base64 frame data are validated before allocation and indexing.
Telemetry portrait SVG is rendered as a bounded data image rather than inserted as live SVG markup.
credential_handling: The UI does not ask the user to embed credentials in the gateway URL.
Evidence captures must redact secret-bearing URL query parameters and sensitive input values.
Screenshots and page-derived artifacts are potentially sensitive and must be stored separately.
browser_network_policy: The default development gateway is loopback at http://127.0.0.1:8090.
SFEB must use a disposable browser and fixture-only network policy.
Do not expose the host CDP debugging port or grant arbitrary private-network navigation to an agent.
artifact_handling: Evidence artifacts are content-addressed and verified before evaluation.
A missing or mismatched digest invalidates the evidence receipt.

hard_gates: No critical keyboard trap or missing accessible name on a required control.
No unredacted sensitive input value in a durable accessibility artifact.
No horizontal page overflow at any declared reference viewport.
The telemetry connected indicator must reflect browser readyState OPEN, not WebSocket construction.
All required browser journeys must pass on the pinned fixture environment.

journeys.goal: Submit a valid query and receive a visible Symthaea response.
steps: Observe the user turn in the log.
oracle: Fixture gateway request log contains the expected query.
Transcript contains the matching user and assistant turns.
Send control is re-enabled after completion.

journeys.goal: Communicate a service or transport failure without losing the interface.
steps: Submit a non-empty query to a fixture endpoint that fails.
Submit a subsequent query after the fixture recovers.
oracle: Error is exposed in a role=alert region.
Send control returns to enabled state.

journeys.goal: Only show telemetry connected after the browser WebSocket reaches OPEN.
steps: Start with a fixture gateway whose handshake is delayed.
Observe disconnected state while readyState is CONNECTING.
oracle: Connected indicator remains false during CONNECTING.
Connected indicator becomes true only at readyState OPEN.

journeys.goal: Recover from a closed or failed telemetry stream without duplicate concurrent sockets.
steps: Observe retry delay and a new connection attempt.
oracle: Only one stream attempt is active at a time.
The current gateway value is used on the next attempt.
A connection lasting at least 60 seconds resets accumulated retry backoff; shorter sessions preserve the failure sequence.

journeys.goal: Preserve readable and operable Converse/Observe regions across viewport classes.
oracle: Named region geometry is recorded for all 16 source anchors.

journeys.goal: Complete the query journey with keyboard-only input.

notes: The contract is derived from source code at source.commit and must not be interpreted as proof of browser behavior.
Changing the gateway endpoint while a WebSocket is already open does not forcibly replace that live connection; the new value is read by the next retry attempt.
No SFEB browser fixture, screenshot baseline or independent acceptance run is included in this contract.
Telemetry retry backoff is reset only after a connection remains open for at least 60 seconds; this avoids resetting after a rapidly flapping socket.
The header element is nested inside the page's main landmark; it is a header section but does not create the document banner landmark implied by a top-level header.
